skills.name: Relationship

moments.text: Frankly, my involvement is what made outside money comfortable. I didn't go looking for it.
Investors trusted that I knew the assets and could get deals done with Enron.
Did your position at Enron play a part in getting investor commitments?
My knowledge of Enron did, certainly. That's why I was valuable to them.
Who first suggested that you serve as the general partner?
I raised it with Ken Lay and Jeff Skilling around the middle of June 1999. I presented it as something the deal needed rather than something I wanted, and they agreed to take it to the Board.
